title: streaming-observability-route-metrics-and-baggage-aware-tracing
author: Ava Kim
release_notes: Adds per-route metric tags and propagates KV baggage into span tags for better correlation across streaming and non-streaming paths. No public API breaking changes.
description: Context and motivation: Production customers reported gaps in correlating streaming responses with backend routing metadata and third-party traces. This PR introduces per-route metric tagging for the streaming pipeline and carries HTTP/KV baggage through the OpenAI-compat shim into internal tracing spans so logs, metrics, and traces can be joined reliably. Changes: 1) route-tagging: attach route_id and route_variant as metric tags on the per-request metrics emitted by the streaming frontier and the response aggregator; 2) baggage propagation: read request-level baggage keys (x-rw-request-id, x-rw-route, custom kv) from the compatibility layer and map them to span tags using the observability contrib helper; 3) structured audit lines: augment JSON access-log entries with route, shim_mode, and trace_id for easier ingestion into ELK/structured sinks; 4) backwards-safe: the compatibility layer falls back to existing request-id header when baggage absent. Commits (high-level): - initial: add route_tag plumbing in streaming frontier and aggregator - followup: map baggage keys into opentracing span tags with unit tests - fix: handle nil baggage map on legacy requests - tests: add integration test exercising streaming + shim + trace correlation - docs: console docs for per-route metrics and an example Kibana query Changed files (high level): - inference/streaming/frontier.go (add tags to metrics emit path) - inference/streaming/aggregator.go (preserve route tag in aggregation counters) - api/openai_compat/shim.go (read baggage and inject into context spans) - observability/tracing/propagator.go (new helper to convert baggage->tags) - logging/json_access.go (augment access log payload) - docs/observability/streaming-route-metrics.md (how to use and example queries) Small illustrative snippet: emitMetrics("tokens_emitted_total", count, map[string]string{"route_id": routeID, "route_variant": rv}) Review conversation summary: - Diego: requested explicit unit tests for nil-baggage and for duplicate header precedence. Author: added tests and updated patch. - Lina: asked to ensure tags are bounded (max length) to avoid metrics cardinality explosion; author added sanitizer and documented limits. - Marco: requested a migration note for Dedicated customers running older private agents; author added a migration section to docs and an opt-out flag in the shim. CI and rollout: initial CI run failed on lint (naming in propagator), fixed in follow-up commit; full CI now passing. Integration bench: smoke-tested on staging with canary traffic (5%) for 48 hours; metrics emitted as expected and traces correlate across OpenTelemetry backend. Risk and rollback: feature guarded behind feature-flag "obs.per_route_tags" and the shim flag "compat.inject_baggage" so we can revert without code rollback. Merge: squash-merged into main on 2026-03-05 (merge commit d3f5a1c8b7). Notes for ops: to enable in Dedicated/Private, set obs.per_route_tags=true and restart shim; upgrading Private package includes new observability config. Related: touches streaming, api-compat, and tracing subsystems; follow-up items include adding route-level SLO dashboards and enabling route tag dimensions in sampling rules.
